fixed_attributes.data_assembly_center: Upper Ocean Processes Group at Woods Hole Oceanographic
fixed_attributes.citation: Data from the NTAS Ocean Reference Station were collected and published by Dr. Albert Plueddemann of the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. The data is made freely available by the OceanSITES project and by the national programs that contribute to it.
fixed_attributes.acknowledgement: This project is funded by the Global Ocean Monitoring and Observing (GOMO) Program, formerly the Ocean Observing and Monitoring Division, Climate Program Office (FundRef number 100007298), National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, under grant NA14OAR4320158.

dynamic_attributes.title: Ocean salinity data from deep sensors on surface mooring NTAS deployment {case_number}

sea_water_temperature.comment: Temperature measured directly by the instrument sensor.

sea_water_practical_salinity.comment: Practical salinity calculated using the TEOS-10 algorithm at the fixed instrument depth.

sea_water_absolute_salinity.comment: Absolute salinity calculated using the TEOS-10 algorithm at the fixed instrument depth.

sea_water_pressure.comment: Pressure comes from instrument without any further processing.

sea_water_electrical_conductivity.comment: Conductivity measured directly by the instrument sensor.
